Stack: React 19 + react-router-dom 6 + Vite 8 (client), Express 4 run by tsx (server), TypeScript strict, Vitest, Playwright.
All dependencies are installed. Do not add packages.

## Layout

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/` | Client. Entry `main.tsx` already imports `styles/tokens.css` (design tokens). |
| `server/index.ts` | Boots Express: `GET /api/health`, `POST /api/reset`, `registerRoutes(app)`, unknown `/api/*` → 404 JSON, static `dist/` + SPA fallback. Rarely needs edits. |
| `server/routes.ts` | Put every API endpoint here inside `registerRoutes(app)`. |
| `server/db.ts` | JSON-file store: `readDb<T>()` returns the whole dataset (mutate it, then `writeDb(db)`), `resetDb()` restores the seed. |
| `server/data/seed.json` | Resolved domain seed copied from `../requirements/seed.json`. The original optional input stays unchanged. `server/data/db.json` is the live copy. |
| `shared/` | Domain types and pure business/validation logic with meaningful `*.test.ts` tests when the brief needs them. No fixed entity names or pricing module is required. |
| `e2e/` | Playwright specs. |
| `visual-evidence/` | Desktop/mobile PNGs for each target in `../design/visual-plan.json`, outside `test-results/`. |

Imports between files are extensionless (`import { x } from './db'`).

## Commands (run from this directory, one plain command at a time)

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `npm run build` | Type-check (`tsc`) then `vite build` into `dist/` |
| `npx vitest run` | Unit tests (`{src,server,shared}/**/*.test.ts(x)`); missing tests fail |
| `npx playwright test` | Builds, starts the server on port 3100, runs `e2e/`; add `--grep "<case-id>"` to run one case |
| `npm start` | Production server on `PORT` (default 3000) serving API + `dist/` — long-running, do not run it yourself |

## Verification contract

Keep one Chromium project and one worker: every test resets the same JSON store.
Call `POST /api/reset` in `beforeEach`; do not run mutation tests in parallel.
Acceptance tests belong in `e2e/case-<id>.spec.ts` with exact IDs from
`../requirements/acceptance.json`. Cases can be supplied by the brief or derived
from requested behavior when the brief has no explicit tests. Additional tests belong in
`journey.spec.ts`, `edge-cases.spec.ts`, `smoke.spec.ts`, and `visual.spec.ts`.
Do not change official expected values or hide failures with retries or skips.

Read `../requirements/product.json` for the actual roles, entities and primary
journey; anonymous and single-screen products are supported. Never introduce
an unrelated marketplace, approval flow, money formula or persona switcher.
For static presentation with no meaningful pure logic, the reviewed product may
set `unit_tests_required: false` and explain `unit_test_reason`; the runner marks
unit verification not applicable only if no existing unit files need execution.

The desktop viewport is 1440×900. Visual tests also use 390×844 via
`page.setViewportSize`, preserving one project and sequential resets. The
designer chooses 1–3 representative screens or states in `../design/visual-plan.json`.
Capture every target in both sizes as `visual-evidence/{desktop|mobile}-{target.id}.png`.
Use `page.screenshot({ path, fullPage: true, animations: 'disabled' })`, attach
the PNG with `testInfo.attach`, and wait for actual content and loaded images
before capture. Assert no horizontal page overflow. Do not use fixed sleeps.

Screenshots support a separate visual review. After polish and final regression,
the visual reviewer reads every final planned PNG and records findings in
`../quality/visual-review.json`; the runner stamps the review and screenshot
and visual-plan hashes in `../quality/evidence.json` so stale evidence cannot pass.

2	
3	## 1. Product and scope
4	Wheels2Go is a peer-to-peer car rental marketplace. **Owners** list cars, manage availability, review booking requests and track earnings. **Renters** browse and filter cars, price a rental, submit a booking request and track bookings.
5	
6	Exclusions: real authentication, payments, messaging, reviews, maps, image upload (image is a URL only), email notifications. Currency is USD (`$1,234.00`, two decimals). Dates are ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` calendar dates, displayed in a readable form.
7	
8	Integration/auth: none required. The brief asks only for a demo account switcher; this is a labeled local demo boundary (no passwords, no sessions security). Persistence is server-side (API + file/DB store) so owner and renter views share data.
9	
10	## 2. Roles and capabilities
11	Demo personas (from seed): Owner Sarah Jenkins (`usr_101`), Renter Alex Rivera (`usr_102`). A persistent header switcher (labeled control "Switch account") changes the active user; the active user persists across refresh (localStorage). Default on first load: Renter.
12	
13	| Capability | Owner | Renter |
14	|---|---|---|
15	| Browse marketplace, filter, view car details | yes | yes |
16	| Book a car | no (cannot book own cars) | yes |
17	| Create/edit/toggle/delete own listings | yes | no |
18	| View/approve/reject booking requests on own cars | yes | no |
19	| Earnings dashboard | yes | no |
20	| My Bookings, cancel own bookings | no | yes |
21	
22	Owner navigation: Marketplace, My Listings, Booking Requests, Earnings. Renter navigation: Marketplace, My Bookings. API enforces role/ownership (403 otherwise) using header `X-User-Id`.
23	
24	## 3. Functional requirements
25	
26	### Account switching
27	- **FR-001** Given the app loads, When no user was chosen, Then Renter Alex Rivera is active and the header shows name and role. When I choose the Owner in "Switch account", Then navigation and data change to owner scope instantly and persist after refresh.
28	
29	### Listing management (Owner)
30	- **FR-010** Given Owner on My Listings, When I choose "Add listing", fill all required fields validly and save, Then the car is created with status `available`, a success message shows, and it appears in My Listings and (as available) in the marketplace immediately.
31	- **FR-011** Given invalid/missing required input, When I save, Then field-level error messages appear next to fields (labeled, `role="alert"`) and nothing is saved. Rules in section 4.
32	- **FR-012** Given an own listing, When I choose Edit and save changes, Then the changes show in My Listings, marketplace and car details. Existing bookings keep their snapshotted prices.
33	- **FR-013** Given an own listing, When I toggle availability, Then status flips between `available` and `unavailable`; unavailable cars remain visible in the marketplace with an "Unavailable" badge and cannot be booked.
34	- **FR-014** Given an own listing, When I choose Delete and confirm, Then it is removed from everywhere. If the car has pending or confirmed bookings, deletion is refused with a clear error (409) — assumption to prevent inconsistent bookings. Cancelled/completed bookings keep a snapshot (see section 4) so history stays readable.
35	- **FR-015** Listing form includes pickup location (city, state, pickup address) and pickup instructions; these are shown to renters on car details and in the booking panel.
36	
37	### Marketplace and filtering (Renter/Owner)
38	- **FR-020** Given cars exist, When I open the marketplace, Then a responsive grid of cards shows: image (with fallback placeholder if URL fails), Make Model Year, daily rate (`$85/day`), fuel type, transmission, seats, location badge (pickup address and city), and availability badge (Available/Unavailable).
39	- **FR-021** Given the filters Make/Brand, Model, Location keyword, Max daily price, Transmission (Any/Automatic/Manual), Fuel type (Any/Gasoline/Hybrid/Electric), When I change any of them, Then results update immediately without a page reload, all filters combined with AND. A "Clear filters" control resets them and a result count is shown.
40	- **FR-022** Given filters match nothing, Then an empty state "No cars match your filters" with Clear filters action is shown.
41	- **FR-023** Given data is loading, Then a loading state is shown; given API failure, an error state with Retry.
42	- **FR-024** Given a card, When I select it, Then a car details view shows the full info, pickup address and instructions, and (for renters) the booking panel.
43	
44	### Booking and pricing (Renter)
45	- **FR-030** Given a car details view as Renter, When I choose start and end dates, Then a live price breakdown shows: days, daily rate, rental subtotal, cleaning fee, total.
46	- **FR-031** Given valid dates and an available car, When I submit "Request booking", Then a booking with status `pending` is created with snapshotted daily rate, cleaning fee, days, total and pickup location; a success message shows with link to My Bookings.
47	- **FR-032** Given invalid dates, When I submit (or when dates change), Then clear errors show: end not after start ("End date must be after start date"), past start ("Start date cannot be in the past"), missing dates. Date inputs also set `min` to today.
48	- **FR-033** Given an overlapping confirmed booking for the car, When I submit, Then it is blocked with "These dates conflict with an existing confirmed booking for this car" (409) and nothing is created.
49	- **FR-034** Given an unavailable car, Then the booking panel is disabled with the message "This car is currently unavailable" and the API returns 409.
50	- **FR-035** Given an Owner is active, Then the booking panel is replaced by a note that owners cannot book (API 403 for owner bookings). An owner also cannot book their own car.
51	
52	### Booking management (Owner)
53	- **FR-040** Given Owner on Booking Requests, Then all bookings for own cars are listed (newest first) with car, renter name/email, dates, days, total, pickup location, and status badge; filter tabs: All, Pending, Confirmed, Cancelled, Completed. Pending requests are highlighted first.
54	- **FR-041** Given a pending booking, When I click "Approve", Then it becomes `confirmed` if no overlap with another confirmed booking exists; otherwise approval fails with the conflict error and the booking stays pending. The change shows immediately in owner view and in renter My Bookings.
55	- **FR-042** Given a pending booking, When I click "Reject", Then it becomes `cancelled` (shown to renter as Cancelled).
56	- **FR-043** Only owners of the car may approve/reject, and only from `pending` (API 403/409 otherwise). The UI shows no approve/reject buttons on non-pending bookings.
57	
58	### Renter bookings
59	- **FR-050** Given Renter on My Bookings, Then own bookings are grouped into Upcoming (pending/confirmed, start in future), Active (confirmed, today within [start, end)), Completed, and Cancelled, each with status badge, car, dates, price breakdown total and pickup location/instructions (instructions visible for confirmed bookings).
60	- **FR-051** Given a pending or confirmed booking that has not started, When Renter clicks "Cancel booking" and confirms, Then status becomes `cancelled`, reflected in owner view, and the dates are freed.
61	- **FR-052** Given a confirmed booking whose end date is before today, Then the effective status is `completed` (derived, see section 5) in both dashboards.
62	
63	### Earnings (Owner)
64	- **FR-060** Given Owner on Earnings, Then it shows: total completed rentals, total revenue earned (sum of total_price of completed bookings), number of pending requests, and a revenue summary: revenue from completed, expected revenue from confirmed upcoming/active, and a per-car table (car, completed count, revenue). Values are `0` / `$0.00` when none, with an empty-state note.
65	
66	### Persistence and reset
67	- **FR-070** Given any create/update/delete, When I refresh, Then data persists (server store). Initial state equals the resolved seed.
68	- **FR-071** `POST /api/reset` restores the seed exactly (active-user selection in localStorage is not part of data).
69	
70	## 4. Domain model
71	**User**: `id`, `name`, `email`, `role` (`owner`|`renter`), `avatar_url`.
72	**Car**: `id` (`car_NN`), `owner_id`, `title` (optional input; default `"{brand} {model} {year}"`), `brand` (req, 1–40), `model` (req, 1–40), `year` (int 1980 – current year+1), `daily_rate` (number >0, ≤10000, max 2 decimals), `cleaning_fee` (number ≥0, ≤1000), `location {city (req), state (optional), pickup_address (req)}`, `pickup_instructions` (req, 1–500), `specs {seats (int 1–12), fuel_type (Gasoline|Hybrid|Electric), transmission (Automatic|Manual)}`, `image_url` (req, http/https URL), `status` (`available`|`unavailable`).
73	**Booking**: `id` (`book_NNN`), `renter_id`, `car_id`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `days`, `daily_rate`, `cleaning_fee`, `total_price` (snapshots), `pickup_location` (snapshot of pickup address), `status` (`pending`|`confirmed`|`cancelled`|`completed`), `created_at` (ISO UTC). API booking responses additionally embed `car` snapshot summary (title, image_url, owner_id) and `renter` (name, email); if the car was deleted, a stored `car_title` snapshot keeps history readable.
74	Relations: Owner 1–N Car; Car 1–N Booking; Renter 1–N Booking.
75	
76	## 5. Business rules
77	- **Days** = whole calendar days between start and end (end − start; exclusive of end date). 2026-12-01→2026-12-04 = 3 days. Minimum 1 day. No timezone conversion: dates are plain calendar dates; "today" is the browser/server local date at action time (UTC on the server).
78	- **Total** = days × daily_rate + cleaning_fee. Money rounded to 2 decimals (half up). Example: 3 × 85 + 25 = **$280.00**; 1 × 110 + 35 = $145.00; 2 × 19.99 + 5 = $44.98.
79	- **Date validation**: start ≥ today (today allowed); end > start; both valid `YYYY-MM-DD`. Past start → error. Max rental length 30 days (assumption; error "Rentals are limited to 30 days").
80	- **Overlap**: ranges are half-open `[start, end)`. A and B overlap iff `A.start < B.end && B.start < A.end`. Same-day turnover (A.end = B.start) is NOT a conflict. Only `confirmed` (and effectively-completed confirmed) bookings of the same car block; pending bookings do not block each other, but approval re-checks conflicts. Example: confirmed 11-10→11-13; request 11-11→11-14 conflicts; 11-13→11-15 does not; 11-07→11-10 does not.
81	- **Effective status**: stored `confirmed` with `end_date < today` is presented as `completed` (computed on read, applied identically in all views, earnings, and conflict logic). Stored pending bookings whose start has passed are still pending (owner may reject).
82	- **Transitions**: pending→confirmed (owner), pending→cancelled (owner reject or renter cancel), confirmed→cancelled (renter, before start only), confirmed→completed (derived). cancelled and completed are terminal.
83	- **Filters**: Make and Model: case-insensitive substring on `brand`/`model`; Location keyword: case-insensitive substring on city, state, or pickup_address; Max price: `daily_rate <= max` (blank = none; invalid/negative treated as an input error); Transmission/Fuel exact match, "Any" = no filter. Example: Make "tesla" + Max 90 → Tesla Model Y ($85) only.
84	- **Earnings**: completed count = effective-completed bookings on own cars; revenue = sum of their `total_price`; pending count = pending bookings on own cars.
85	- **Unit-testable pure logic**: days/total calculation, date validation, overlap detection, effective status, filter function, earnings aggregation, listing validation.
86	
87	## 6. API and persistence contract
88	JSON; errors `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "fields"?: {field: message} } }` with 400 (validation), 403, 404, 409. Active user passed via `X-User-Id`. Shared TypeScript types for User/Car/Booking/etc. are used by server and client.
89	
90	- `GET /api/health` → `{ "ok": true }`.
91	- `POST /api/reset` → restores seed exactly; `{ "ok": true }`.
92	- `GET /api/users` → `User[]` (for the switcher).
93	- `GET /api/cars` → `Car[]` (all, including unavailable). Filtering is client-side or optional query params.
94	- `GET /api/cars/:id` → `Car` (404 if missing).
95	- `POST /api/cars` (owner) body: Car fields without `id`, `owner_id`, `status` → 201 `Car`; 400 with `fields`.
96	- `PUT /api/cars/:id` (owner of car) body: same fields plus optional `status` → `Car`.
97	- `PATCH /api/cars/:id/availability` (owner of car) body `{ "status": "available"|"unavailable" }` → `Car`.
98	- `DELETE /api/cars/:id` (owner of car) → 204; 409 if pending/confirmed bookings.
99	- `GET /api/bookings` → bookings scoped to the active user (renter: own; owner: on own cars), with effective status, embedded `car` and `renter`.
100	- `POST /api/bookings` (renter) body `{ car_id, start_date, end_date }` → 201 `Booking` (pending); 400 dates, 404 car, 409 unavailable/conflict, 403 owner.
101	- `PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status` body `{ "status": "confirmed"|"cancelled" }` → `Booking`. Owner of car: confirm/reject pending; renter owner of booking: cancel pending/confirmed pre-start; other → 403/409.
102	- `GET /api/earnings` (owner) → `{ completed_rentals, total_revenue, pending_requests, confirmed_revenue, by_car: [{car_id,title,completed_rentals,revenue}] }`.
103	
104	Persistence: server-side store initialized from the resolved seed on first start; survives restarts/refresh; reset rewrites it.
105	
106	## 7. Primary journey
107	See `product.json`. Renter filters Tesla, opens Model Y, selects 2026-12-01→12-04, sees $280.00, submits → Pending in My Bookings. Owner switches account, approves in Booking Requests → Confirmed. Renter switches back, sees Confirmed. Refresh retains everything. Both dashboards read the same API data, so no manual sync is required; switching account refetches.
108	
109	## 8. UI and non-functional
110	- Responsive from 360px (no horizontal scroll; grid 1 column on mobile, 2–3 on larger); modern, premium look with consistent typography, spacing, and colors.
111	- All inputs have visible labels; all controls keyboard-operable with visible focus; buttons have text/aria-labels; status badges use text plus color (Pending amber, Confirmed green, Cancelled red/gray, Completed blue).
112	- Loading, empty, error, and success states (toast/inline `role="status"`) for lists and mutations. Destructive actions (delete, cancel, reject) ask for confirmation.
113	- Stable test hooks: `data-testid` on car cards (`car-card`), filters (`filter-make`, `filter-model`, `filter-location`, `filter-max-price`, `filter-transmission`, `filter-fuel`), `account-switcher`, price breakdown (`price-days`, `price-daily-rate`, `price-subtotal`, `price-cleaning-fee`, `price-total`), `booking-card`, `status-badge`, approve/reject buttons.
114	- A README with run instructions and demo accounts is required deliverable.
115	
116	## 9. Resolved seed and traceability
117	`requirements/seed.json` = `input/seed.json` (2 users, 3 cars, 1 confirmed booking `book_301` Miami Tesla 2026-11-10→11-13, $280) with all original records and values preserved. The only addition is `pickup_instructions` on each of the 3 cars, because the brief requires this field on every listing. The seed is compatible with the brief (no mismatch). No completed booking is added, so Earnings initially shows 0 completed rentals/$0.00 revenue and $280.00 expected from confirmed (this is intentional to preserve the original dataset).
118	
119	Traceability (all acceptance cases are supplied, mode `provided`):
120	| Source | FR |
121	|---|---|
122	| TR-1 listing creation | FR-010, 011, 015, 020 |
123	| TR-2 search/filter | FR-021, 022 |
124	| TR-3 pricing | FR-030 |
125	| TR-4 approval | FR-031, 040, 041, 050 |
126	| TR-5 conflicts | FR-033, 041 |
127	| TR-6 persistence | FR-070, 010, 031 |
128	| Roles + switcher | FR-001, FR-035 |
129	| Edit/toggle/delete | FR-012, 013, 014 |
130	| Reject/status lifecycle | FR-042, 043, 051, 052 |
131	| Earnings | FR-060 |
132	| Validation/error states | FR-011, 023, 032, 034 |
133	| Seed/reset | FR-070, 071 |
134	Derived checks (not supplied): 30-day limit, same-day turnover allowed, owner cannot book, delete blocked with active bookings, renter cancellation, empty state.
135	
136	## 10. Assumptions and limitations
137	- Demo switcher is not authentication; `X-User-Id` is trusted.
138	- Brief's commented-out first section mentions "Airport Hub" as location; in the form this is entered as the pickup address (city also required).
139	- Cancel by renter, 30-day max, delete-blocking and effective-completed derivation are minimal assumptions needed for a consistent lifecycle.
140	- Owners cannot manually mark completion; completion happens by date.
141	- Image URLs are remote (Unsplash); a fallback placeholder is shown offline/broken.
142	- Unit tests are required (pricing, dates, overlap, filters, validation, earnings).
143

- **FR-020** Given cars exist, When I open the marketplace, Then a responsive grid of cards shows: image (with fallback placeholder if URL fails), Make Model Year, daily rate (`$85/day`), fuel type, transmission, seats, location badge (pickup address and city), and availability badge (Available/Unavailable).
- **FR-021** Given the filters Make/Brand, Model, Location keyword, Max daily price, Transmission (Any/Automatic/Manual), Fuel type (Any/Gasoline/Hybrid/Electric), When I change any of them, Then results update immediately without a page reload, all filters combined with AND. A "Clear filters" control resets them and a result count is shown.
- **FR-022** Given filters match nothing, Then an empty state "No cars match your filters" with Clear filters action is shown.
- **FR-023** Given data is loading, Then a loading state is shown; given API failure, an error state with Retry.
- **FR-024** Given a card, When I select it, Then a car details view shows the full info, pickup address and instructions, and (for renters) the booking panel.

### Booking and pricing (Renter)
- **FR-030** Given a car details view as Renter, When I choose start and end dates, Then a live price breakdown shows: days, daily rate, rental subtotal, cleaning fee, total.
- **FR-031** Given valid dates and an available car, When I submit "Request booking", Then a booking with status `pending` is created with snapshotted daily rate, cleaning fee, days, total and pickup location; a success message shows with link to My Bookings.
- **FR-032** Given invalid dates, When I submit (or when dates change), Then clear errors show: end not after start ("End date must be after start date"), past start ("Start date cannot be in the past"), missing dates. Date inputs also set `min` to today.
- **FR-033** Given an overlapping confirmed booking for the car, When I submit, Then it is blocked with "These dates conflict with an existing confirmed booking for this car" (409) and nothing is created.
- **FR-034** Given an unavailable car, Then the booking panel is disabled with the message "This car is currently unavailable" and the API returns 409.
- **FR-035** Given an Owner is active, Then the booking panel is replaced by a note that owners cannot book (API 403 for owner bookings). An owner also cannot book their own car.

### Booking management (Owner)
- **FR-040** Given Owner on Booking Requests, Then all bookings for own cars are listed (newest first) with car, renter name/email, dates, days, total, pickup location, and status badge; filter tabs: All, Pending, Confirmed, Cancelled, Completed. Pending requests are highlighted first.
- **FR-041** Given a pending booking, When I click "Approve", Then it becomes `confirmed` if no overlap with another confirmed booking exists; otherwise approval fails with the conflict error and the booking stays pending. The change shows immediately in owner view and in renter My Bookings.
- **FR-042** Given a pending booking, When I click "Reject", Then it becomes `cancelled` (shown to renter as Cancelled).
- **FR-043** Only owners of the car may approve/reject, and only from `pending` (API 403/409 otherwise). The UI shows no approve/reject buttons on non-pending bookings.

### Renter bookings
- **FR-050** Given Renter on My Bookings, Then own bookings are grouped into Upcoming (pending/confirmed, start in future), Active (confirmed, today within [start, end)), Completed, and Cancelled, each with status badge, car, dates, price breakdown total and pickup location/instructions (instructions visible for confirmed bookings).
- **FR-051** Given a pending or confirmed booking that has not started, When Renter clicks "Cancel booking" and confirms, Then status becomes `cancelled`, reflected in owner view, and the dates are freed.
- **FR-052** Given a confirmed booking whose end date is before today, Then the effective status is `completed` (derived, see section 5) in both dashboards.

### Earnings (Owner)
- **FR-060** Given Owner on Earnings, Then it shows: total completed rentals, total revenue earned (sum of total_price of completed bookings), number of pending requests, and a revenue summary: revenue from completed, expected revenue from confirmed upcoming/active, and a per-car table (car, completed count, revenue). Values are `0` / `$0.00` when none, with an empty-state note.

### Persistence and reset
- **FR-070** Given any create/update/delete, When I refresh, Then data persists (server store). Initial state equals the resolved seed.
- **FR-071** `POST /api/reset` restores the seed exactly (active-user selection in localStorage is not part of data).

## 4. Domain model
**User**: `id`, `name`, `email`, `role` (`owner`|`renter`), `avatar_url`.
**Car**: `id` (`car_NN`), `owner_id`, `title` (optional input; default `"{brand} {model} {year}"`), `brand` (req, 1–40), `model` (req, 1–40), `year` (int 1980 – current year+1), `daily_rate` (number >0, ≤10000, max 2 decimals), `cleaning_fee` (number ≥0, ≤1000), `location {city (req), state (optional), pickup_address (req)}`, `pickup_instructions` (req, 1–500), `specs {seats (int 1–12), fuel_type (Gasoline|Hybrid|Electric), transmission (Automatic|Manual)}`, `image_url` (req, http/https URL), `status` (`available`|`unavailable`).
**Booking**: `id` (`book_NNN`), `renter_id`, `car_id`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `days`, `daily_rate`, `cleaning_fee`, `total_price` (snapshots), `pickup_location` (snapshot of pickup address), `status` (`pending`|`confirmed`|`cancelled`|`completed`), `created_at` (ISO UTC). API booking responses additionally embed `car` snapshot summary (title, image_url, owner_id) and `renter` (name, email); if the car was deleted, a stored `car_title` snapshot keeps history readable.
Relations: Owner 1–N Car; Car 1–N Booking; Renter 1–N Booking.

## 5. Business rules
- **Days** = whole calendar days between start and end (end − start; exclusive of end date). 2026-12-01→2026-12-04 = 3 days. Minimum 1 day. No timezone conversion: dates are plain calendar dates; "today" is the browser/server local date at action time (UTC on the server).
- **Total** = days × daily_rate + cleaning_fee. Money rounded to 2 decimals (half up). Example: 3 × 85 + 25 = **$280.00**; 1 × 110 + 35 = $145.00; 2 × 19.99 + 5 = $44.98.
- **Date validation**: start ≥ today (today allowed); end > start; both valid `YYYY-MM-DD`. Past start → error. Max rental length 30 days (assumption; error "Rentals are limited to 30 days").
- **Overlap**: ranges are half-open `[start, end)`. A and B overlap iff `A.start < B.end && B.start < A.end`. Same-day turnover (A.end = B.start) is NOT a conflict. Only `confirmed` (and effectively-completed confirmed) bookings of the same car block; pending bookings do not block each other, but approval re-checks conflicts. Example: confirmed 11-10→11-13; request 11-11→11-14 conflicts; 11-13→11-15 does not; 11-07→11-10 does not.
- **Effective status**: stored `confirmed` with `end_date < today` is presented as `completed` (computed on read, applied identically in all views, earnings, and conflict logic). Stored pending bookings whose start has passed are still pending (owner may reject).
- **Transitions**: pending→confirmed (owner), pending→cancelled (owner reject or renter cancel), confirmed→cancelled (renter, before start only), confirmed→completed (derived). cancelled and completed are terminal.
- **Filters**: Make and Model: case-insensitive substring on `brand`/`model`; Location keyword: case-insensitive substring on city, state, or pickup_address; Max price: `daily_rate <= max` (blank = none; invalid/negative treated as an input error); Transmission/Fuel exact match, "Any" = no filter. Example: Make "tesla" + Max 90 → Tesla Model Y ($85) only.
- **Earnings**: completed count = effective-completed bookings on own cars; revenue = sum of their `total_price`; pending count = pending bookings on own cars.
- **Unit-testable pure logic**: days/total calculation, date validation, overlap detection, effective status, filter function, earnings aggregation, listing validation.

## 6. API and persistence contract
JSON; errors `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "fields"?: {field: message} } }` with 400 (validation), 403, 404, 409. Active user passed via `X-User-Id`. Shared TypeScript types for User/Car/Booking/etc. are used by server and client.

- `GET /api/health` → `{ "ok": true }`.
- `POST /api/reset` → restores seed exactly; `{ "ok": true }`.
- `GET /api/users` → `User[]` (for the switcher).
- `GET /api/cars` → `Car[]` (all, including unavailable). Filtering is client-side or optional query params.
- `GET /api/cars/:id` → `Car` (404 if missing).
- `POST /api/cars` (owner) body: Car fields without `id`, `owner_id`, `status` → 201 `Car`; 400 with `fields`.
- `PUT /api/cars/:id` (owner of car) body: same fields plus optional `status` → `Car`.
- `PATCH /api/cars/:id/availability` (owner of car) body `{ "status": "available"|"unavailable" }` → `Car`.
- `DELETE /api/cars/:id` (owner of car) → 204; 409 if pending/confirmed bookings.
- `GET /api/bookings` → bookings scoped to the active user (renter: own; owner: on own cars), with effective status, embedded `car` and `renter`.
- `POST /api/bookings` (renter) body `{ car_id, start_date, end_date }` → 201 `Booking` (pending); 400 dates, 404 car, 409 unavailable/conflict, 403 owner.
- `PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status` body `{ "status": "confirmed"|"cancelled" }` → `Booking`. Owner of car: confirm/reject pending; renter owner of booking: cancel pending/confirmed pre-start; other → 403/409.
- `GET /api/earnings` (owner) → `{ completed_rentals, total_revenue, pending_requests, confirmed_revenue, by_car: [{car_id,title,completed_rentals,revenue}] }`.

Persistence: server-side store initialized from the resolved seed on first start; survives restarts/refresh; reset rewrites it.

## 7. Primary journey
See `product.json`. Renter filters Tesla, opens Model Y, selects 2026-12-01→12-04, sees $280.00, submits → Pending in My Bookings. Owner switches account, approves in Booking Requests → Confirmed. Renter switches back, sees Confirmed. Refresh retains everything. Both dashboards read the same API data, so no manual sync is required; switching account refetches.

## 8. UI and non-functional
- Responsive from 360px (no horizontal scroll; grid 1 column on mobile, 2–3 on larger); modern, premium look with consistent typography, spacing, and colors.
- All inputs have visible labels; all controls keyboard-operable with visible focus; buttons have text/aria-labels; status badges use text plus color (Pending amber, Confirmed green, Cancelled red/gray, Completed blue).
- Loading, empty, error, and success states (toast/inline `role="status"`) for lists and mutations. Destructive actions (delete, cancel, reject) ask for confirmation.
- Stable test hooks: `data-testid` on car cards (`car-card`), filters (`filter-make`, `filter-model`, `filter-location`, `filter-max-price`, `filter-transmission`, `filter-fuel`), `account-switcher`, price breakdown (`price-days`, `price-daily-rate`, `price-subtotal`, `price-cleaning-fee`, `price-total`), `booking-card`, `status-badge`, approve/reject buttons.
- A README with run instructions and demo accounts is required deliverable.

## 9. Resolved seed and traceability
`requirements/seed.json` = `input/seed.json` (2 users, 3 cars, 1 confirmed booking `book_301` Miami Tesla 2026-11-10→11-13, $280) with all original records and values preserved. The only addition is `pickup_instructions` on each of the 3 cars, because the brief requires this field on every listing. The seed is compatible with the brief (no mismatch). No completed booking is added, so Earnings initially shows 0 completed rentals/$0.00 revenue and $280.00 expected from confirmed (this is intentional to preserve the original dataset).

Traceability (all acceptance cases are supplied, mode `provided`):
| Source | FR |
|---|---|
| TR-1 listing creation | FR-010, 011, 015, 020 |
| TR-2 search/filter | FR-021, 022 |
| TR-3 pricing | FR-030 |
| TR-4 approval | FR-031, 040, 041, 050 |
| TR-5 conflicts | FR-033, 041 |
| TR-6 persistence | FR-070, 010, 031 |

| Edit/toggle/delete | FR-012, 013, 014 |
| Reject/status lifecycle | FR-042, 043, 051, 052 |
| Earnings | FR-060 |
| Validation/error states | FR-011, 023, 032, 034 |
| Seed/reset | FR-070, 071 |
Derived checks (not supplied): 30-day limit, same-day turnover allowed, owner cannot book, delete blocked with active bookings, renter cancellation, empty state.

## 10. Assumptions and limitations
- Demo switcher is not authentication; `X-User-Id` is trusted.
- Brief's commented-out first section mentions "Airport Hub" as location; in the form this is entered as the pickup address (city also required).
- Cancel by renter, 30-day max, delete-blocking and effective-completed derivation are minimal assumptions needed for a consistent lifecycle.
- Owners cannot manually mark completion; completion happens by date.
- Image URLs are remote (Unsplash); a fallback placeholder is shown offline/broken.
- Unit tests are required (pricing, dates, overlap, filters, validation, earnings).

1	# Wheels2Go — UI Spec
2	
3	Tokens: `design/tokens.css` (imported directly by the app) / `design/tokens.json`. All values below refer to token names.
4	
5	## 1. Visual direction
6	"Clean automotive marketplace": light neutral canvas (`--color-bg`), white cards with `--shadow-card` and `--radius-md`, a dark ink header (`--color-header-bg`) and one teal accent (`--color-primary`) used only for primary actions, active nav and links. Hierarchy: page title (`--font-size-xl`, bold) → card title (`--font-size-lg`, bold) → price (bold, `--font-size-lg`) → metadata (`--font-size-sm`, `--color-text-muted`). Car imagery is the main visual: card images are 16:10, `object-fit: cover`, top-rounded. Status is always text plus color via status tokens (pending amber, confirmed green, cancelled red, completed blue, unavailable gray). Spacing scale: 16px inside cards, 24px between sections, 16px grid gap. Money `$1,234.00` (two decimals) in breakdowns/totals; `$85/day` on cards (no decimals when whole, else two decimals). No invented trust claims, ratings or reviews.
7	
8	## 2. App shell
9	- Header (all screens, dark): brand link "Wheels2Go" (`data-testid="brand-link"`, to `/`), primary nav (role-dependent), then user area at right: avatar, name and role text (`data-testid="current-user"`, e.g. "Alex Rivera · Renter"), and the "Switch account" `<select>` (`data-testid="account-switcher"`, `aria-label="Switch account"`) whose options are the users, option label `"{name} ({Owner|Renter})"`, option value = user id (`usr_101`, `usr_102`). Changing it immediately switches scope, persists in localStorage and navigates to `/` (marketplace).
10	- Nav links (`data-testid="nav-marketplace"`, `nav-my-bookings`, `nav-my-listings`, `nav-booking-requests`, `nav-earnings`). Renter: Marketplace, My Bookings. Owner: Marketplace, My Listings, Booking Requests, Earnings. Active link has `aria-current="page"` and an underline in primary-on-dark (white text, 3px bottom border).
11	- Mobile (<768px): header wraps into two rows: row 1 brand + switcher; row 2 horizontally scrollable-free nav that wraps (flex-wrap). No hamburger.
12	- Content: centered, max `--width-content`, side padding `--space-4` (mobile) / `--space-5` (desktop). Narrow pages use `--width-narrow`/`--width-form`.
13	- Feedback: toasts container (`data-testid="toast"`, `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`) fixed top-right below header (full-width minus 16px on mobile), success (green tokens) or error (red tokens), auto-dismiss not required; also a dismiss button "Dismiss". Inline success/error messages in forms use their own testids below.
14	- Demo label: small muted text in footer "Demo accounts — no real authentication." (`data-testid="demo-note"`).
15	
16	## 3. Screens and states
17	Routes: `/` marketplace; `/cars/:id` details; `/my-bookings` (renter); `/owner/listings`; `/owner/listings/new`; `/owner/listings/:id/edit`; `/owner/requests`; `/owner/earnings`. Owner-only routes visited as renter (and vice versa) show `data-testid="access-denied"` text "This page is not available for your account." with a link to Marketplace.
18	
19	### `/` Marketplace (both roles)
20	- Page title "Find a car" (h1). Filter panel (white card): six controls in a responsive grid (desktop 1440: 3 columns × 2 rows inside the 1200 content; mobile 390: 1 column). Below it a row: result count (`data-testid="result-count"`, "3 cars") and "Clear filters" button (`data-testid="clear-filters"`).
21	- Grid: `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(var(--width-card-min), 1fr))`, gap 16px → 3 columns at 1440, 1 column at 390/360.
22	- Card: image, title line "Make Model Year", availability badge overlaid top-left of image, price "$85/day", chips for fuel, transmission, "5 seats", and a location badge (pin text "Miami International Airport Hub - Zone B · Miami"). Whole card is a link ("View details") to `/cars/:id`.
23	- Loading: `data-testid="loading"` "Loading cars…". Error: `data-testid="error-state"` with message and "Retry" button (`data-testid="retry"`). Empty (no match): `data-testid="empty-state"` "No cars match your filters" + Clear filters button (`data-testid="empty-clear-filters"`).
24	
25	### `/cars/:id` Car details
26	- Back link "Back to marketplace". Desktop: two columns — left (flex 1): large image (16:10), title h1, badges, spec list (year, fuel, transmission, seats, daily rate, cleaning fee), pickup location, address and instructions; right: sticky booking panel width `--width-booking-panel`. Mobile: single column, booking panel after details.
27	- Booking panel (renter): start date and end date inputs, live price breakdown, "Request booking" button (full width). Owner: note instead. Unavailable car: disabled panel with message.

29	
30	### `/my-bookings` (renter)
31	Title "My Bookings". Sections in order, each with a heading and count: Upcoming, Active, Completed, Cancelled (`data-testid="group-upcoming"`, `group-active`, `group-completed`, `group-cancelled`); empty groups show muted "No bookings" text. Booking cards (single column list, max `--width-narrow` is NOT applied; full content width) show thumbnail, car title, dates, days, total, pickup location, status badge, instructions (confirmed only), and "Cancel booking" for pending/confirmed not started. Empty overall: `data-testid="empty-state"` "You have no bookings yet" with link "Browse cars".
32	
33	### `/owner/listings`
34	Title "My Listings", "Add listing" button/link (`data-testid="add-listing"`) to `/owner/listings/new`. List of own cars as rows/cards (desktop: image left, details center, actions right; mobile: stacked) with availability badge and actions Edit, "Make unavailable"/"Make available", Delete. Empty: `empty-state` "You have no listings yet".
35	
36	### `/owner/listings/new` and `/:id/edit`
37	Form card width `--width-form`. Title "Add listing"/"Edit listing". Buttons "Save listing" (submit) and "Cancel" (link back). On success navigate to `/owner/listings` and show toast "Listing created"/"Listing updated". Field errors display under each field.
38	
39	### `/owner/requests`
40	Title "Booking Requests". Filter tabs (`role="tablist"`-free simple buttons with `aria-pressed`): All, Pending, Confirmed, Cancelled, Completed with counts not required. List of booking cards (pending first, then newest first). Each card: car title, renter name + email, dates, days, total, pickup location, status badge, and for pending only "Approve" and "Reject". Empty for tab: `empty-state` "No booking requests".
41	
42	### `/owner/earnings`
43	Title "Earnings". Four stat tiles in a row (desktop 4 columns, mobile 1–2 columns): Completed rentals, Total revenue, Pending requests, Expected from confirmed. Below: "Revenue by car" table (car, completed rentals, revenue) — on mobile the table stays inside a wrapper with `overflow-x:auto`; page itself has no horizontal scroll. Empty note when no completed rentals: "No completed rentals yet."

45	## 4. Components
46	- **Button**: height `--control-height`, radius `--radius-sm`, bold. Primary (teal bg, white text), secondary (white, border), danger (`--color-danger` bg, white text). Disabled: 50% opacity, `cursor:not-allowed`, `disabled` attribute. Focus ring via global `:focus-visible`.
47	- **Field**: visible `<label>` above control, control height `--control-height`, border `--color-border`, radius `--radius-sm`; error text `--color-danger` below with `role="alert"` and control `aria-invalid="true"`, linked via `aria-describedby`.
48	- **StatusBadge** (`data-testid="status-badge"`, `data-status="pending|confirmed|cancelled|completed"`): pill, text capitalized ("Pending"). Availability badge (`data-testid="availability-badge"`, `data-status="available|unavailable"`): "Available" uses confirmed tokens, "Unavailable" uses unavailable tokens.
49	- **CarCard**, **BookingCard**, **PriceBreakdown**, **Toast**, **ConfirmDialog**: native `<dialog>`-style modal (`role="alertdialog"`, `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby`), focus moves to Cancel button on open, Escape closes. Buttons: `data-testid="confirm-yes"` (label "Confirm") and `data-testid="confirm-no"` (label "Keep"/"Cancel" per context: use "Go back"). Used for Delete listing, Reject, Cancel booking.
50	- **StatTile**, **Tabs**, **Header/AccountSwitcher**.

52	## 5. Binding test contract
53	Language: English. Selectors by `data-testid` unless noted. Repeated entities carry `data-id` (car id like `car_01`, booking id like `book_301`) on the same element as their testid.
54	
55	### Marketplace
56	- `car-card` (`data-id` = car id): contains `car-title` ("Tesla Model Y 2023"? — shows title text as stored: seed car_01 shows "Tesla Model Y Long Range 2023"; cars created without a title show "{Make} {Model} {Year}"), `car-price` ("$85/day"), `car-location` (text includes pickup address and city, e.g. "Airport Hub"), `car-fuel` ("Electric"), `car-transmission` ("Automatic"), `car-seats` ("5 seats"), `availability-badge`. Card link `car-link` (navigates to `/cars/:id`). Image `car-image` (`alt` = title); on error replaced by a placeholder with `data-testid="image-fallback"`.
57	- Filters (all inside `data-testid="filters"`, each with visible label): `filter-make` text "Make / Brand"; `filter-model` text "Model"; `filter-location` text "Location keyword"; `filter-max-price` `type="number"` `min="0"` `step="any"` label "Max daily price ($)"; `filter-transmission` `<select>` options values `""` ("Any"), `Automatic`, `Manual`; `filter-fuel` `<select>` options `""` ("Any"), `Gasoline`, `Hybrid`, `Electric`. Filtering applies on input (no submit button). Invalid max price (negative) shows `role="alert"` text "Max price must be a positive number" (`data-testid="filter-max-price-error"`) and the max filter is ignored.
58	- `result-count`: "{n} car" / "{n} cars" (e.g. "1 car"). `clear-filters` resets all six controls. Seed expectation: unfiltered 3 cars; Make "Tesla" → 1; Make "Tesla" + Max 90 → only Tesla Model Y.

61	- `car-detail` root with `data-id`; `detail-title`, `detail-price`, `detail-cleaning-fee` ("$25.00"), `detail-location` (address + city, state), `detail-instructions`, `detail-seats`, `detail-fuel`, `detail-transmission`, `availability-badge`.

Before valid dates are chosen, the breakdown shows placeholder "—" in `price-days`, `price-subtotal`, `price-total`, and rate/fee still show car values. Submit `booking-submit` (text "Request booking").
63	- Date errors `booking-error` (`role="alert"`) with exact texts: "Select a start and end date", "End date must be after start date", "Start date cannot be in the past", "Rentals are limited to 30 days", conflict "These dates conflict with an existing confirmed booking for this car". # Wheels2Go — UI Spec

Tokens: `design/tokens.css` (imported directly by the app) / `design/tokens.json`. All values below refer to token names.

## 1. Visual direction
"Clean automotive marketplace": light neutral canvas (`--color-bg`), white cards with `--shadow-card` and `--radius-md`, a dark ink header (`--color-header-bg`) and one teal accent (`--color-primary`) used only for primary actions, active nav and links. Hierarchy: page title (`--font-size-xl`, bold) → card title (`--font-size-lg`, bold) → price (bold, `--font-size-lg`) → metadata (`--font-size-sm`, `--color-text-muted`). Car imagery is the main visual: card images are 16:10, `object-fit: cover`, top-rounded. Status is always text plus color via status tokens (pending amber, confirmed green, cancelled red, completed blue, unavailable gray). Spacing scale: 16px inside cards, 24px between sections, 16px grid gap. Money `$1,234.00` (two decimals) in breakdowns/totals; `$85/day` on cards (no decimals when whole, else two decimals). No invented trust claims, ratings or reviews.

## 2. App shell
- Header (all screens, dark): brand link "Wheels2Go" (`data-testid="brand-link"`, to `/`), primary nav (role-dependent), then user area at right: avatar, name and role text (`data-testid="current-user"`, e.g. "Alex Rivera · Renter"), and the "Switch account" `<select>` (`data-testid="account-switcher"`, `aria-label="Switch account"`) whose options are the users, option label `"{name} ({Owner|Renter})"`, option value = user id (`usr_101`, `usr_102`). Changing it immediately switches scope, persists in localStorage and navigates to `/` (marketplace).
- Nav links (`data-testid="nav-marketplace"`, `nav-my-bookings`, `nav-my-listings`, `nav-booking-requests`, `nav-earnings`). Renter: Marketplace, My Bookings. Owner: Marketplace, My Listings, Booking Requests, Earnings. Active link has `aria-current="page"` and an underline in primary-on-dark (white text, 3px bottom border).
- Mobile (<768px): header wraps into two rows: row 1 brand + switcher; row 2 horizontally scrollable-free nav that wraps (flex-wrap). No hamburger.
- Content: centered, max `--width-content`, side padding `--space-4` (mobile) / `--space-5` (desktop). Narrow pages use `--width-narrow`/`--width-form`.
- Feedback: toasts container (`data-testid="toast"`, `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`) fixed top-right below header (full-width minus 16px on mobile), success (green tokens) or error (red tokens), auto-dismiss not required; also a dismiss button "Dismiss". Inline success/error messages in forms use their own testids below.
- Demo label: small muted text in footer "Demo accounts — no real authentication." (`data-testid="demo-note"`).

## 3. Screens and states
Routes: `/` marketplace; `/cars/:id` details; `/my-bookings` (renter); `/owner/listings`; `/owner/listings/new`; `/owner/listings/:id/edit`; `/owner/requests`; `/owner/earnings`. Owner-only routes visited as renter (and vice versa) show `data-testid="access-denied"` text "This page is not available for your account." with a link to Marketplace.

### `/` Marketplace (both roles)
- Page title "Find a car" (h1). Filter panel (white card): six controls in a responsive grid (desktop 1440: 3 columns × 2 rows inside the 1200 content; mobile 390: 1 column). Below it a row: result count (`data-testid="result-count"`, "3 cars") and "Clear filters" button (`data-testid="clear-filters"`).
- Grid: `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(var(--width-card-min), 1fr))`, gap 16px → 3 columns at 1440, 1 column at 390/360.
- Card: image, title line "Make Model Year", availability badge overlaid top-left of image, price "$85/day", chips for fuel, transmission, "5 seats", and a location badge (pin text "Miami International Airport Hub - Zone B · Miami"). Whole card is a link ("View details") to `/cars/:id`.
- Loading: `data-testid="loading"` "Loading cars…". Error: `data-testid="error-state"` with message and "Retry" button (`data-testid="retry"`). Empty (no match): `data-testid="empty-state"` "No cars match your filters" + Clear filters button (`data-testid="empty-clear-filters"`).

### `/cars/:id` Car details
- Back link "Back to marketplace". Desktop: two columns — left (flex 1): large image (16:10), title h1, badges, spec list (year, fuel, transmission, seats, daily rate, cleaning fee), pickup location, address and instructions; right: sticky booking panel width `--width-booking-panel`. - Booking panel (renter): start date and end date inputs, live price breakdown, "Request booking" button (full width). Owner: note instead. Unavailable car: disabled panel with message.

### `/my-bookings` (renter)
Title "My Bookings". ### `/owner/listings`
Title "My Listings", "Add listing" button/link (`data-testid="add-listing"`) to `/owner/listings/new`. ### `/owner/listings/new` and `/:id/edit`
Form card width `--width-form`. Title "Add listing"/"Edit listing". Buttons "Save listing" (submit) and "Cancel" (link back). On success navigate to `/owner/listings` and show toast "Listing created"/"Listing updated". Field errors display under each field.

### `/owner/requests`

Peer-to-peer car rental demo: owners list cars and approve requests, renters browse, price and book.

- `npm run build` then `npm start` (serves API and client on `PORT`, default 3000)

- Data lives in `server/data/db.json`, initialized from `server/data/seed.json`. `POST /api/reset` restores the seed.
- Car images are remote URLs; a placeholder shows when they fail to load.
- Assumptions: rentals are limited to 30 days, cars with pending or confirmed bookings cannot be deleted, renters may cancel before the start date.
